name: B10-0064/2026 (PPE) – Presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the presidential election in Honduras. It says the result, which made Nasry Asfura president-elect, must be respected. It rejects a decree by the outgoing president ordering a recount, calling it against the constitution. It condemns an bomb attack that injured an opposition deputy and calls for the outgoing authorities to hand over power peacefully.

- The Parliament backs the announced election result and rejects the outgoing president's recount decree.
- It affects Honduran leaders, election officials and opposition deputies facing violence.
- Next, the European Union's top diplomat is asked to watch the handover of power closely.
